https://trlibrary.com/tr/badlands/landsc.description: Eroded buttes, deep coulees, and the Little Missouri River shape the Dakota Badlands—the wild country that reshaped a young Theodore Roosevelt.

https://trlibrary.com/tr/early-life/sibl.title: TR’s Siblings: Bamie, Elliott, and Corinne—Family at Its Best and Worst

https://trlibrary.com/tr/conservation/by.title: Conservation by the Numbers

https://trlibrary.com/tr/presidency/exec.title: Executive Power: The Stewardship Theory and Modern Presidency
https://trlibrary.com/tr/presidency/exec.description: Roosevelt reimagined the presidency itself, arguing the office empowered a president to act for the public good unless the Constitution expressly forbade it.

https://trlibrary.com/tr/badlands-timeli.title: Timeline of TR in the Badlands

https://trlibrary.com/tr/presidency/ten-.title: Ten Facts About Theodore Roosevelt's Presidency
https://trlibrary.com/tr/presidency/ten-.description: Ten facts about Theodore Roosevelt’s presidency — from the youngest man ever to take the office to trust-busting, conservation, and the Square Deal.

https://trlibrary.com/tr/people/bill-sew.title: Bill Sewall: The Maine Woodsman Who Knew the Real TR
https://trlibrary.com/tr/people/bill-sew.description: A rugged Maine backwoodsman, Bill Sewall guided a young, asthmatic Roosevelt through the wilderness and became a lifelong, trusted friend.

https://trlibrary.com/tr/presidency.title: Theodore Roosevelt's Presidency
https://trlibrary.com/tr/presidency.description: Step inside Roosevelt's presidency — the Square Deal, the Panama Canal, trust-busting, and a bully pulpit that redefined what the office could do.

https://trlibrary.com/tr/quotes/leadersh.title: Theodore Roosevelt on Leadership
https://trlibrary.com/tr/quotes/leadersh.description: Roosevelt's own words on leadership, from picking capable people and trusting them to lead to his conviction that decisive action beats hesitation.

https://trlibrary.com/tr/early-life/harv.description: Arriving at Harvard in 1876 at seventeen, Theodore brought insatiable curiosity and a body remade by exercise, becoming a historian and political thinker.

https://trlibrary.com/tr/speeches/new-na.title: The New Nationalism (1910)
https://trlibrary.com/tr/speeches/new-na.description: Roosevelt's progressive manifesto, delivered August 31, 1910 at Osawatomie, Kansas, laying out a bolder vision of government serving the public good.

https://trlibrary.com/tr/rise-to-power/a.description: As Assistant Secretary of the Navy, Roosevelt built his naval policy on Alfred Thayer Mahan's doctrine that a great nation required command of the sea.

https://twincitiesfrugalmom.com/2026/08/.description: Discover the best things to do in Medora, North Dakota, from Theodore Roosevelt National Park and the Medora Musical to museums, dining and more.

https://trlibrary.com/tr/badlands.title: Theodore Roosevelt in the Badlands
https://trlibrary.com/tr/badlands.description: Ride into Roosevelt's Dakota Badlands years — the buffalo hunt, the cattle ranches, and the grief and grit that remade a young man bound for the presidency.

https://trlibrary.com/tr/rise-to-power.title: Theodore Roosevelt's Rise to Power
https://trlibrary.com/tr/rise-to-power.description: Trace Roosevelt's climb from Rough Rider to the White House — San Juan Hill, a vice presidency meant to sideline him, and the fateful autumn of 1901.

https://trlibrary.com/tr/presidency/fore.title: Roosevelt's Foreign Policy: America Takes Its Place Among Nations
https://trlibrary.com/tr/presidency/fore.description: As president from 1901, Theodore Roosevelt steered America out of cautious isolation into an assertive foreign policy that lifted the nation among world powers.

https://trlibrary.com/tr/conservation.title: Roosevelt and the Conservation Story
https://trlibrary.com/tr/conservation.description: Roosevelt's conservation story told in numbers and his own words — some 230 million acres of forests, parks, and refuges protected for the future.
